Topic: Instantaneous Rate of Change and the Derivative

Target audience: High school students (Introduction to Calculus)

Section: section_1 — The Problem of Average Speed

Lecture lines:
Cheetahs run 100 meters in 5 seconds.
Average speed is distance divided by time.
100 meters divided by 5 seconds is 20 m/s.

Planned animations:
Create a curve representing position over time.
Draw a secant line between two points on the curve.
Change the color of the secant line to #FF4500.

Section: section_2 — Shrinking the Interval (The Secant Line)

Lecture lines:
Connect two points with a secant line.
Watch the interval shrink on our graph.
The secant line moves closer to the curve.

Planned animations:
Show two points moving closer together on the curve.
Update the secant line as points move.
Flash the slope value in #00FFFF near the line.

Section: section_3 — Defining Instantaneous Rate (The Tangent Line)

Lecture lines:
As time shrinks, points merge together.
The secant line becomes a tangent line.
This represents speed at one exact moment.
We call this the instantaneous rate.
It is the slope at that specific point.

Planned animations:
Show the secant line approaching a single tangent point.
Highlight the tangent point in #FFFF00.
Draw a tangent line at that point.

Section: section_4 — Formalizing the Derivative

Lecture lines:
Mathematically, the derivative is a limit.
Limit h approaches zero of the slope formula.
f prime of x equals the limit.
This finds the exact velocity at time t.
It provides precision for every changing rate.

Planned animations:
Display the limit definition of the derivative.
Highlight Δx approaching 0 in #FF00FF.
Show the derivative notation f'(x) in #00FF00.

Section: section_5 — Application and Summary

Lecture lines:
The derivative measures instantaneous rates.
Think of inflating balloons or interest rates.
Derivatives describe change at any exact moment.

Planned animations:
Show a real-world example like velocity from position.
Summarize the transition from secant to tangent.
Display the final derivative formula clearly.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):

        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        lines = ["Cheetahs run 100 meters in 5 seconds.", "Average speed is distance divided by time.", "100 meters divided by 5 seconds is 20 m/s."]

import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

            "It is the slope at that specific point."
        ])

        curve = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.25 * x**2, x_range=[0, 4], color=BLUE)

        self.wait(1)

        p1.set_color("#FFFF00")
        self.wait(1)

        self.lecture[3].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FF00FF")
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Application and Summary", [
            "The derivative measures instantaneous rates.",
            "Think of inflating balloons or interest rates.",
            "Derivatives describe change at any exact moment."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # The derivative measures instantaneous rates.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(BLUE)
        
        velocity_text = MathTex("v(t) = \\lim_{\\Delta t \\to 0} \\frac{s(t+\\Delta t) - s(t)}{\\Delta t}")
        self.place_at_grid(velocity_text, 'B2', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Write(velocity_text))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Think of inflating balloons or interest rates.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        balloon = Circle(radius=0.5, color=RED).set_fill(RED, opacity=0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(balloon, 'E2', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(FadeIn(balloon), GrowFromCenter(balloon))
        self.play(balloon.animate.scale(1.5), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Derivatives describe change at any exact moment.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)
        
        formula = MathTex("f'(x) = \\lim_{h \\to 0} \\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}")
        self.place_at_grid(formula, 'B5', scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(2)
